### coagglomeration

3 distinct version prepared <br>
-- all 3-digit NACE industries <br>
-- only manufacturing 3-digit NACE industries <br>
-- only MNEs in all 3-digit NACE industries <br>

all 3 distinct versions are prepared for 3 region types <br>
-- megye (NUTS 3) <br>
-- jaras (LAU 1) <br>
-- urban agglomeration (20) <br>


```{r}
# results=FALSE, message=FALSE

source("../scripts/02_coagglomeration_exploration_functions.R")
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
library(mefa4)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggraph)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# choose aggregation
region <- "megye"
industry <- "nace3d"

# coagglomeration -- reconstructed data
coagg_df <- fread(paste0("../data/oc_2022_november/coagglomeration_manufacturing_", industry, "_", region, "_totalemp.csv"), encoding='Latin-1')

```
